description: This header file declares functions related to buffering data on disk within a lighttpd server module, including starting and stopping a disk-based buffer filter.

methods.name: li_filter_buffer_on_disk
methods.description: Initializes a disk-based buffer filter for a virtual request with configurable flush limit and chunk splitting options.

methods.name: li_filter_buffer_on_disk_stop
methods.description: Stops the disk-based buffer filter stream.
